claims.text: Linear baselines close the gap with transformers on short-horizon forecasts over Exchange, ILI, Traffic.
DLinear is best characterised as decomposition linear baseline.

evidence.description: At horizon 96, DLinear was within 3% MSE of the best transformer on 3 datasets.

limitations.text: The training corpus is limited to a single domain, so cross-domain robustness is not established.
Confidence intervals or standard errors are not reported for the headline metric.

future_work.text: Evaluating robustness to missing values and label noise.
Pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer.
